activity_summary: Upstairs you said the purse had been right, and that the page would hold. You had wiped your shoes. You did not turn it into a loan, and you stopped.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Spoke the two sums, refused the loan, and stopped.

facets.activity: Said the page would hold, and stopped

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Tenpence a head, and one penny of his, and I am the man who stood up.
